title: Comparative Molecular Docking Analysis, of Natural and Synthetic Ligands, Targeting BRCA1, BRCA2, ER, and PR in Breast Cancer Treatment.
authors: Turini, Stefano; Dunjic, Momir; Nejkovic, Lazar; Pikula, Aleksandra; Novakovic, Tatjana; Dunjic, Marija; Dunjic, Katarina
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接比较天然与合成配体对BRCA1/BRCA2/ER/PR的结合亲和力，虽涉及蛋白-配体对接，但对象为小分子药物而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合或互作机制，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Breast cancer remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality in women, necessitating the development of innovative therapeutic strategies. This study employs comparative molecular docking to evaluate the binding affinities of natural compounds, derived from a specifically formulated oil mixture, against key molecular targets in breast cancer BRCA1, BRCA2, estrogen receptor (ER), and progesterone receptor (PR). METHODS: Synthetic ligands commonly used in breast cancer therapy were included as reference compounds. Molecular docking was performed using 1-Click Docking software to determine binding energy values, expressed in kcal/mol, with more negative DeltaG values indicating stronger and more spontaneous ligand-receptor interactions. RESULTS: Among the synthetic ligands, Epirubicin exhibited the highest binding affinity to BRCA2 (-9.0 kcal/mol), while Capecitabine demonstrated the strongest interaction with PR (-8.1 kcal/mol). Notably, the natural compound Narirutin outperformed these drugs, showing a superior binding affinity to BRCA2 (-9.2 kcal/mol) and PR (-8.9 kcal/mol). Additionally, Geraniol and Citronellol exhibited competitive binding affinities to ER and PR, respectively, underscoring their potential therapeutic relevance. These findings highlight the capability of natural compounds to act as effective inhibitors of critical breast cancer molecular targets. Narirutin, in particular, stands out as a promising candidate for further exploration in integrative cancer therapies. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates the utility of bioinformatics approaches, specifically molecular docking, in identifying natural compounds with high therapeutic potential and provides a computational framework for future experimental validation and drug development.
abstract_zh: 目的：乳腺癌仍然是女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因，因此亟需开发创新性治疗策略。本研究采用比较分子对接 (comparative molecular docking) 方法，评估源自特定配方油混合物 (oil mixture) 的天然化合物对乳腺癌关键分子靶点BRCA1、BRCA2、雌激素受体 (estrogen receptor, ER) 和孕激素受体 (progesterone receptor, PR) 的结合亲和力。方法：将乳腺癌治疗中常用的合成配体作为参考化合物。使用1-Click Docking软件进行分子对接 (molecular docking)，以确定结合能值，单位为kcal/mol，其中更负的DeltaG值表示更强、更自发的配体-受体相互作用。结果：在合成配体中，表柔比星 (Epirubicin) 对BRCA2表现出最高的结合亲和力（-9.0 kcal/mol），而卡培他滨 (Capecitabine) 与PR的相互作用最强（-8.1 kcal/mol）。值得注意的是，天然化合物柚皮苷 (Narirutin) 优于这些药物，对BRCA2（-9.2 kcal/mol）和PR（-8.9 kcal/mol）显示出更优越的结合亲和力。此外，香叶醇 (Geraniol) 和香茅醇 (Citronellol) 分别对ER和PR表现出竞争性结合亲和力，凸显了其潜在的治疗相关性。这些发现强调了天然化合物作为乳腺癌关键分子靶点有效抑制剂的能力。柚皮苷尤其作为整合癌症治疗中进一步探索的有前景候选物脱颖而出。结论：本研究展示了生物信息学方法（特别是分子对接）在识别具有高治疗潜力的天然化合物方面的实用性，并为未来的实验验证和药物开发提供了计算框架。
